name: Template: 7am owner brief from the Twilio message log

parameters.content:
## 7am owner brief from your Twilio message log
Every morning this reads the texts on your business number straight from Twilio and sends you one short summary: how many customers texted in, how many texts went out, anything that failed to deliver, and who is still waiting on a reply.

### How it works
1. A schedule runs at 7am in your time zone.
2. It looks up your Twilio account and pulls the last 8 days of texts to and from your business number.
3. A Code node counts customer texts in the lookback window, flags undelivered messages and lists conversations where the customer sent the last text.
4. Your own cell and STOP replies are left out, so the numbers reflect real customers.
5. The brief is texted to your cell. On a quiet day you can skip it.

### Setup steps
1. Add a Twilio credential (Account SID and Auth Token) and select it on the three HTTP Request nodes and the Twilio node.
2. Open **Your settings** and fill in business_number and owner_cell in +1XXXXXXXXXX format, plus your time zone.
3. Set the workflow time zone in workflow settings so 7am is your 7am.
4. Run it once with Execute workflow, check the text on your phone, then activate it.

## 1. Schedule and settings
Runs at 7am. **Your settings** holds your two numbers, your time zone, lookback_hours (default 24), max_waiting_listed (default 5) and skip_if_quiet.

## 2. Read the Twilio log
Finds your Account SID, then pulls texts to and from your business number for the last 8 days. The wider pull is what lets an old unanswered text still show up as waiting.

## 3. Build and send the brief
Counts customer traffic only, lists who is waiting newest first and texts you the brief. With skip_if_quiet on, a quiet day sends nothing.
